blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The whole-day impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte will resume next week, December 1-4, according to Senate secretary Renato Bantug. The impeachment trial was suspended this week to give way to the marathon plenary deliberations of the proposed P7.2-trillion national budget for fiscal year 2027. READ: VP Duterte faces Senate on OVP budget, dodges impeach questions “The Impeachment Court, upon the instruction of the Presiding Officer, hereby advises all concerned that whole-day trial will be conducted on December 1, 2, 3, and 4, 2026 (Tuesday to Friday), 10:00 a.m. onwards,” Bantug said in an advisory.
